workflow: Merging multiple Excel files with inconsistent column headers into a single consolidated sheet
trigger: Monthly reporting cycle requiring combination of department-level Excel exports
current_workaround: Manually copy-pasting each sheet into a master workbook, then adjusting column names and formats by hand
consequence: Hours of tedious work, high risk of header mismatches and data loss, delays in report delivery

workflow: Programmatically merging large Excel files (over 100 MB each) using pandas read_excel, leading to memory errors and crashes
trigger: Ad-hoc requests to combine historical data from multiple Excel files
current_workaround: Splitting files into smaller chunks, using VBA loops instead of pandas, or upgrading to a machine with more RAM
consequence: Frequent script failures, wasted developer time debugging memory issues, inability to process full datasets

workflow: Removing duplicate rows when merging Excel files from different sources, where duplicates are not exact matches
trigger: Weekly consolidation of sales data from regional offices
current_workaround: Manually comparing rows using conditional formatting, then deleting duplicates by hand; sometimes using Excel's Remove Duplicates but it fails on fuzzy matches
consequence: Inaccurate reports, overcounted or undercounted metrics, hours of manual verification
